title: Refuse brief and worker-start mistakes by command
body:
Outcome: lead mistakes in briefs and worker starts are refused by commands before any worker turn, not caught by memory or prose. Operator 2026-11-03: "Ty kurwa nie umiesz promptować i używać naszego systemu, nie wiesz co kurwa dawać do --allow ... Przejmij ten projekt. Ogarnij tu wszystko. Każdą najmniejszą instrukcję."
Evidence (t-n9b3q2g session, .krn/runs/lead/acceptance-checks/): (1) lead listed .agents/skills/krn-lead/SKILL.md in --allow although spec/worker-scope.json forbids it; start exited 64 and a turn was lost. (2) brief had settled decisions but no ordered steps and no test-first step; gpt-6-luna skipped the observer for two rounds (round 2: 566 output tokens, cumulative 8.8k output / 1.55M input). (3) an M-effort, 5-file change went to luna instead of sol.
Deliver:
1. `krn brief check <brief> --repo <worktree>` also parses `## Allowed paths` and refuses (exit 65, one line per path) any path matching spec/worker-scope.json forbidden patterns, and prints the exact `--allow`/`--require` argv the lead must pass, so the start command is generated, not typed.
2. `krn brief check` requires a `## Steps` numbered section whose first step creates the observer named in `## Proof` and runs it red; refuse a brief without it.
3. `krn worker start` refuses `--allow` lists that differ from the brief's `## Allowed paths` (exit 64 naming the difference).
4. lead skill + lead-rules: model routing rule "more than 3 changed files or audit effort M → gpt-6.1-sol", stated once in the table; `krn brief check` warns when Allowed has more than 3 non-test paths and --model is luna.
5. Measure: a reader subagent analyses the three rollouts of t-n9b3q2g (rounds/001-003 rollout_path) and records why turns ended early; the result decides whether item 4 is enough.
Proof: test/brief/allowed-paths.test.ts red at base by assertion.

Also (retro t-n9b3q2g): generate the review lens from the brief's Settled decisions verbatim so settled test seams are not re-litigated (#191 attempt 3 prepass flagged KRN_WORKER_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS, budget exception + override spent); and the lead skill step 7 must say a budget-exception attempt takes no --prior-record (exit 64 'already a second-round record').
